author: BHUVANSH855
body_preview: ### Documentation  As of 3.14, `Py_EnterRecursiveCall` and `Py_LeaveRecursiveCall` no longer use a call counter (`c_recursion_remaining`); they compare the current C stack pointer against `tstate->c_stack_soft_limit`.
